hypotheses.A: Separating own, market and sector trailing returns and OLS residual strength adds complementary information to the existing OOS forecasts, improving both direction and magnitude.
hypotheses.B: A relative-strength expert can be combined with the existing research price-pattern forecast via a fixed average, matured OOS convex stacking, or a predeclared market-condition role switch.

evaluation: Fixed last half of source origin dates; retain all issuer/date rows and missing-input fallbacks. Prior history already inspected; exploratory only.
features: Five existing OOS log forecasts, own trailing 63/126/252 log returns, volatility63, distance200, drawdown63; SPY and sector ETF trailing returns63/126/252 and distance200. Relative expert additionally uses own-minus-SPY and own-minus-sector returns, 252-observation OLS betas and intercept-removed residual cumulative returns63/126/252. All new raw input dates strictly precede origin. Sector identities are the current universe, not point-in-time classifications.
data: Yahoo adjusted daily closes retrieved in this run, raw payload hashes and compact extracted features saved. No backfilled ETF history before launch. Historical revisions and current-member survivorship remain.
loss: absolute_error on future/current price ratio, date-equal weights, no class balancing or desired sign quotas
training: Only origin < current origin and targetDate < current origin; source origin/target intervals are disjoint by horizon, verified before execution. Horizons fitted independently. No new classifier or calibration claims.
simpleTrend: Exp(horizon/126 * previous-close trailing126 log return), clipped only to min/max ratios of matured labels; no probability
bounds: Clip every new regressor/stack output to matured target min/max, report counts
stack: Weights [0, .25, .5, .75, 1] selected by equal-date (MAPE + return MAE) on previous matured OOS expert forecasts, ties lower expert weight. Require at least3 OOS origins; otherwise retain priceOnly. No holdout tuning.
bearRoute: Use relative expert only when previous-close SPY distance200 <0 and expert value <.98, otherwise priceOnly. Fixed market condition, no learned holdout threshold.
missing: Missing own or SPY feature -> priceOnly for all new forecasts, preserve row; unavailable sector features remain NaN, OLS sector beta0 with market-only regression. All missing status retained.
direction: Final numeric ratio >1.02 up, <.98 down, otherwise neutral; always-up direction comparator recorded separately
probability: No probability outputs from numeric experts/blends; Brier/logloss explicitly not applicable, not borrowed from another classifier
extraGate: Reuse unchanged blend gates: improve MAPE and return MAE against both noChange and priceOnly by2%; no worse tails; both directions and precision pass. Also require falseDownWarningRate <= priceOnly and consistency against simpleTrend and absolute_control; prospective always false.
abstention: No abstention; neutral forecasts are a predicted class, not excluded rows
prospective: Preserve genuinely issued after-publication forecasts separately when a timely complete snapshot is available. Never call historical replay an issued forecast. This run is historical research only.
